---
title: "Island Transit real-time feed: status"
---

This site archives the real-time bus data published by
[Island Transit](https://www.islandtransit.org/) (Whidbey and Camano
Islands, Washington) and measures how good that data is, using the error
framework survey researchers apply to any data source. It also estimates
on-time performance from bus positions, checked automatically every day
and in person on route 60.

## Collector, live

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
STATUS_URL = "https://ekczqlmunyumtgtthppb.supabase.co/rest/v1/status_now"
PUBLIC_KEY = "sb_publishable_AWlvBYVrlTz7dEaf7RwwzA_5zRN3af-"
status = {
  try {
    const r = await fetch(STATUS_URL, {headers: {apikey: PUBLIC_KEY}});
    return r.ok ? await r.json() : null;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}
feedName = ({vehiclePositions: "Vehicle positions", tripUpdates: "Trip updates", serviceAlerts: "Service alerts"})
ago = s => s == null ? "never" : s < 120 ? `${s} s ago` : s < 7200 ? `${Math.round(s / 60)} min ago` : `${Math.round(s / 3600)} h ago`
html`${status == null
  ? html`<p>The collector could not be reached from this page just now.</p>`
  : html`<div class="stat-row">${["vehiclePositions", "tripUpdates", "serviceAlerts"].map(f => {
      const s = status.find(d => d.feed === f) || {};
      return html`<div class="stat">
        <div class="label">${feedName[f]}</div>
        <div class="value">${ago(s.last_ok_age_s)}</div>
        <div class="note">last successful fetch · ${s.last_entity_count ?? "–"} entities ·
          today ${s.ok_today ?? 0} of ${s.attempts_today ?? 0} fetches succeeded</div>
      </div>`;
    })}</div>
    <p class="note">Collecting since ${new Date(status[0]?.collecting_since).toLocaleString("en-US", {timeZone: "America/Los_Angeles", dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short"})} Pacific.
    Vehicle positions and trip updates are requested every 20 seconds, alerts every 5 minutes.</p>`}`
```

## Latest complete day

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {csv, pct, num} from "./lib.js"
quality = csv(d3, "data/quality/daily.csv")
ontime = csv(d3, "data/ontime/daily.csv")
q = quality.at(-1)
o = ontime.at(-1)
html`${q == null
  ? html`<p>No day has been processed yet. The first complete service day is processed shortly after midnight Pacific.</p>`
  : html`<p>Service day <strong>${q.service_date instanceof Date ? q.service_date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) : q.service_date}</strong>
     (Pacific calendar date). <a href="quality.html">All quality figures</a>.</p>
  <div class="stat-row">
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">Scheduled trips seen in the feed</div>
      <div class="value">${pct(q.trip_coverage)}</div>
      <div class="note">of ${q.scheduled_trips} scheduled trips</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">Collector uptime, vehicle positions</div>
      <div class="value">${pct(q.vehicle_uptime, 1)}</div>
      <div class="note">20-second slots with a successful fetch</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">Age of positions when first seen</div>
      <div class="value">${num(q.position_age_s_median)} s</div>
      <div class="note">median; 95th percentile ${num(q.position_age_s_p95)} s</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="label">On time at timepoints</div>
      <div class="value">${o ? pct(o.on_time_share_of_observed) : "–"}</div>
      <div class="note">${o ? `of observed events; ${pct(o.observed_share)} of scheduled events observed` : "not yet computed"}</div></div>
  </div>`}`
```

## What is published

- **Raw archive**: every response from the three feeds, exactly as received,
  one file per day, in the repository's
  [Releases](https://github.com/dfladagermccullugh-bot/Open-Island-Transit-Data/releases).
- **Parsed tables**: vehicle positions, trip updates, stop predictions,
  alerts and inferred stop events, as Parquet files.
- **Daily metrics**: feed quality and on-time summaries, on the
  [`data` branch](https://github.com/dfladagermccullugh-bot/Open-Island-Transit-Data/tree/data).

See [Data](data.qmd) for file descriptions and [Methods](methods.qmd) for
how each figure is defined.
